Thanks Samantha — great to meet you over the phone. Short answer: we need the following to create a full vendor master record and enable PO routing to AP:

- Legal entity name (as on tax filings)
- Tax ID / VAT number (country-specific)
- Registered/legal address (for contracts)
- Primary invoice remit address (postal / email)
- AP contact for invoice escalation (name, email, phone)
- Banking details for ACH or wire (account name, account number, routing/swift) — finance will validate separately
- W-9 or equivalent (for US vendors) or certificate of tax residency if outside US
- Beneficial ownership / UBO if requested by compliance (we'll flag if needed)

I've looped in Kimberly from Finance (to validate bank proof) and Marissa from Vendor Ops (who will open the record). Please upload the files via our onboarding portal link below or reply with attachments. If you'd like, we can run a quick portal walkthrough — takes about 10 minutes.

Portal: https://redwood-inference.app/onboarding/portal?token=xyz123

Attachment: Acme_Onboarding_Form.pdf received.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the remit email and preferred PO-to-POC (name/email).
2) Upload legal docs + bank proof to the portal.
3) Marissa — can you create a draft vendor record and hold until we receive bank verification?

Best,

Logan Wright
